name: neural-weights-en-au
$comment: Initial en-au overlay (2026-08-08) — country-scope delivery only. Ships NO postcode-au.bin (no AU postcode shard built), NO pair-index-au.bin (PIX1 not yet calibrated for AU), NO anchor-lexicon (anchor channel OFF for en-au). The overlay exists so --locale en-AU resolves and the resolver's country scope constrains the candidate lookup — that alone fixes the WA→Washington-State homonym class diagnosed in the 2026-08-07 FIRST-PASS benchmark (8 WA rows misrouted ≥15,000 km under en-US default). Follow-ups: AU postcode shard build, PIX1 pair-index calibration, address-point layer from OA au/countrywide.csv.
model_lineage: Data-only overlay. Ships NO model.onnx/tokenizer.model — resolves both from @mailwoman/neural-weights-en-us via mailwoman.baseWeights (byte-identical encoder).
phase: INITIAL — country scope only. Not yet evaluated on an AU board; the benchmark evidence is the 8 WA-scattered-rows class in FIRST_PASS.md.

au_artifacts.no_postcode_bin: FOLLOW-UP: this overlay ships NO postcode-au.bin — no AU postcode shard exists on disk. Until one is built, the postcode-anchor channel resolves OFF for en-au loads.
au_artifacts.no_pair_index: FOLLOW-UP: this overlay ships NO pair-index-au.bin — PIX1 placetype-pair retrieval not yet calibrated for AU. The AU address register (GNAF/OA) is needed for pair extraction.
au_artifacts.no_anchor_lexicon: FOLLOW-UP: this overlay ships NO anchor-lexicon — anchor channel OFF (same posture as en-nz).

architecture.$comment: Verbatim copy of the base card's architecture.

requires.$comment: Verbatim copy of the base card's requires block. NOTE: anchor.required is true (the encoder is anchor-trained) but this overlay ships no postcode-au.bin — anchor channel OFF on en-au loads.
